claims.claim_ar: نداء مباشر بـ«يا أهل الكتاب» كتحويلٍ لخطاب المخاطب العام إلى مخاطبة صريحة ومباشرة؛ وظيفة بلاغية: لفت الانتباه والتوبيخ والاستدراك.
claims.claim_en: Direct vocative address 'O People of the Book' (ya Ahl al-Kitab) effecting an iltifat (shift of address); rhetorically it draws attention and serves as reproaching/direct exhortation.

claims.claim_ar: استعمال «الـ» في «الكتاب» للتأطير والتعميم (تعيين فئة: أهل الكتاب) بحيث يُعرَّفون كمجموعة محددة يستهدفها الخطاب القرآني.
claims.claim_en: Use of the definite article 'al-' in 'al-kitab' to frame and generalize the addressees as a defined collective ('People of the Book'); rhetorically it groups them as the intended audience of the reproach.
claims.needs_review_reason: Commentarial tradition records alternative readings (e.g., specific delegations vs. general group), so whether the article signals strict generality or a particular subset needs confirmatory sourcing.

warnings: Source chunks provided are excerpts of al-Kashshaf (Zamakhshari). Other requested authors (al-Jurjani, al-Sakkaki, al-Baqillani, al-Suyuti, tafsir balagha) are not present in the chunks, so claims derive from the available Zamakhshari material only.

Only claims that could be tied to exact substrings in the supplied chunks were extracted. Additional rhetorical readings (e.g., repetition of «الْحَقَّ» as takrār, antithetic pairing of الحقّ/الباطل as tibāq) may be valid but were not asserted because the exact supporting substrings were not present in the provided chunks.
